title: Decorator Pattern for HTTP Pipelines — Companion Code
title_es: Patrón Decorator para pipelines HTTP — Código complementario
description: Runnable TypeScript decorator stack for HTTP clients: fetch wrapper, logging, selective retry with backoff+jitter, auth header, and a real half-open circuit breaker, composed through a factory.
description_es: Stack de decoradores TypeScript ejecutable para clientes HTTP: wrapper de fetch, logging, reintentos selectivos con backoff+jitter, header de auth y un circuit breaker con half-open real, compuestos mediante una factory.
